mission: To nurture a lifelong, mutually beneficial relationship between REVA University and its global alumni community, promoting academic excellence, professional mentorship, and alma mater pride.
overview: The REVA University Alumni Association (RUAA) serves as the official link between the university and our global network of over 35,000 graduates. Headquartered at Rukmini Knowledge Park, Bengaluru, RUAA fosters professional collaboration, hosts the annual Grand Alumni Meet, expands international chapters, and empowers students through mentorship and industry engagement.
address: REVA University Alumni Association (RUAA), Office of Alumni Relations, Administrative Block, Rukmini Knowledge Park, Kattigenahalli, Yelahanka, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India - 560064

initiatives.title: RUAA Grand Alumni Meet
initiatives.description: Annual flagship convention celebrated at Rukmini Knowledge Park uniting alumni across all batches and schools, featuring milestone reunions and the Distinguished Alumni Awards.

initiatives.title: Alumni Assist Desk
initiatives.description: Streamlined single-window institutional service for transcripts, migration/transfer certificates, duplicate degree verification, and academic credential endorsement.

initiatives.title: Student Mentorship & Career Referrals
initiatives.description: Direct student-alumni mentorship network facilitating corporate internships, resume critiques, mock technical interviews, and placement referrals across Fortune 500 companies.

initiatives.title: REVA NEST Startup Incubation
initiatives.description: Partnership with REVA NEST Technology Business Incubation Centre providing alumni-founded ventures with seed funding access, co-working facilities, and patent advisory.

initiatives.title: Global City Chapters
initiatives.description: Active regional chapters across Bengaluru, Delhi-NCR, Hyderabad, Mumbai, USA (Silicon Valley & East Coast), UK (London), UAE (Dubai), and Singapore.
